            f"Region groups should be {set(REGION_STATS.keys())}, got {seen}."
        )
        for gv, s, c, a in rows:

            assert s == exp_sum, f"Group {gv} sum should be {exp_sum}, got {s}."
            assert c == exp_count, f"Group {gv} count should be {exp_count}, got {c}."
